name: Batch merge sampler (tile batch items into one latent mid-run)
plain: Runs a wrapped sampler up to merge_step on the whole batch, then concatenates the batch items side by side (horizontal) or stacked (vertical) into one larger latent, with optional blended overlaps, and finishes sampling on that latent with the same or a second sampler. An advanced text plan can lay out a grid of items with flips and one-pixel rolls. Only the first plan line is used; the seed is bumped by 1000 for the second half. Conditioning is not resized, so it relies on the model accepting the larger shape.
math:
Symbols: σ_0..σ_N schedule; m merge_step.
x_m = S1(x, σ_0..σ_m); X = tile(x_m[0..B−1]) with overlap band o: X[...,−o:] = blend(left[...,−o:], right[...,:o], β).
out = S2(X, σ_m..σ_N).

props.params: mode horizontal|vertical, merge_step 5, hoverlap 0, voverlap 0, blend_mode lerp, blend_strength 0.5, sampler_after optional, advanced_plan optional
